page.layout: One printed block at the top, centred: a heading line, about six short lines of text, then a spaced-capital heading. Below it, a central woodcut ornament with a small line beneath. No running head, page number or margin text. Show-through from the reverse side is faint in the lower half.
page.notes: The top block and the spaced heading are too faint and worn to read reliably; the lines above are marked illegible rather than guessed. The central ornament is a woodcut device with no legible text. The small line under the ornament is also illegible. The faint marks in the lower half are show-through and were left out.
